headline: Fisherman's Row Line Settles; Callahan's Passage Flares Anew
war_summary: The half-settled line at Fisherman's Row has come to order: both waste squares are now claimed, one by each side, leaving eight Colonial squares to a single Warden hold. The day produced forty-eight base events there, though only two in the past two hours. Callahan's Passage has taken up the war's immediate weight — twelve events in two hours and thirty-two across the day, most of them about The Latch — and now stands nine Warden squares to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf keeps its long split of four Warden against five Colonial after forty-one events, Breaker Town alone bearing twenty-five of them. The Weathered Expanse remains the furnace: forty-four events in the day and five in the last two hours, casualties near 1,166 Colonial and 1,810 Warden an hour, Warden colors on two squares, Colonial on six, and one laid waste. Nevish Line holds seven Warden squares to one Colonial under steady fire, while Linn Mercy's eleven squares remain Colonial, its Warden losses running near 227 an hour. Across some 430 strongpoints, Colonial banners fly over roughly 300; six regions still show more than one color.
